steps.en: Run its Docker image once, exposing port 8899 (API and UI) and 8081 (forward proxy)
steps.zh: 用 Docker 镜像起一次，开放 8899 和 8081 两个端口

steps.en: Keeps crawling public proxy sources in the background and saves candidates to a local database
steps.zh: 在后台持续爬公开代理来源，候选存进本地数据库

steps.en: Re-validates each proxy and records latency, stability, anonymity and HTTPS support
steps.zh: 反复校验每个代理，记下延迟、稳定性、匿名性和 HTTPS 支持

steps.en: Ask the JSON API for proxies, filtered by HTTPS, anonymity or country
steps.zh: 向 JSON API 要代理，按 HTTPS、匿名性或国家过滤

steps.en: Returns only proxies currently marked valid, each with its latency and stability score
steps.zh: 只返回当前判定有效的代理，附带延迟和稳定性分数

steps.en: Plug the returned ip:port into your requests or Scrapy client
steps.zh: 把返回的 ip:port 填进 requests 或 Scrapy 客户端

value.en: A standing, scored free-proxy pool that many scraping jobs can query, instead of each job harvesting its own
value.zh: 一个常驻、带打分的免费代理池，多个爬虫任务都来查它，不用各自去收割

sources: https://github.com/MikeChongCan/scylla#json-api (/api/v1/proxies with anonymous, https, countries parameters; sample result fields latency, stability, is_valid)
